description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a client; the server assigns the number (INV-YYYY-NNNN), computes taxes from the client's jurisdiction and rounds per invoice rules — never state amounts yourself. Lines need description, qty and unitPrice (decimal). Due date defaults to 14 days from today. Pass a stable requestId when retrying: the same requestId returns the same invoice instead of creating a duplicate. Use send_invoice to email it — do NOT send without the user's confirmation.

depositPercent.description: Booking deposit: this percent of the total is collected by the payment link now; the balance link follows after. Omit for no deposit.

name: create_invoice
